
## Installing on Windows

1. Download **`OuraBox_VERSION_x64-setup.exe`** below.
2. Open it. Windows may say it's from an unknown publisher, because the installer isn't signed yet: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
3. To update, install the new version over the old one: your spaces stay where they are.

You can check the file with `SHA256SUMS.txt`: in PowerShell, `Get-FileHash OuraBox_VERSION_x64-setup.exe` should print the same hash.

**Before you start:** it's a beta. It doesn't update itself, its encryption hasn't had an external review yet, and it may have bugs. Save an encrypted backup (Settings → Security) now and then, somewhere else. Linux and macOS aren't tried yet.

Something got in the way? [Open an issue](https://github.com/viraloyster/OuraBox/issues). A security problem? [Never in public](https://github.com/viraloyster/OuraBox/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
